Cc: Ben Spencer <security@hightower.io>
Date: Sun, 24 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 evidence transfer — next steps

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We're starting the evidence collection for our SOC 2 review and want to confirm the most secure and friction-free way to get artifacts over to Redwood. Our security team prefers either SFTP with user-based keys or S3 pre-signed URLs; we also accept Box/SharePoint when customers require it.

Can you share Redwood's preferred intake method and any requirements around encryption/packaging (PGP, zipped + AES, checksums)? We'll be sending logs (application + gateway), config screenshots, and a handful of service account audit extracts. Also wondering if Redwood can provide a sample log export (for format confirmation) and the expected retention window you typically show on a SOC 2 spreadsheet.

I've attached our intake packet to give you a sense of scope (Hightower_SIG_Request_2025.pdf). Would like to schedule a short call to align transfer ops + owners — are you available Mon/Tue morning PT?

Appreciate it,
Alice Weaver
Security Program Manager
Hightower Inc.

Attachments: Hightower_SIG_Request_2025.pdf

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Alice Weaver <alice@hightower.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 24 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence transfer — next steps

Hi Alice — thanks for the packet, looks straightforward. Short answer: we prefer S3 pre-signed URLs for bulk uploads (short-lived, auditable) or secure SFTP when customer policy requires a traditional host. We also support encrypted archives (AES-256) and can verify checksums (sha256) on receipt. PGP is available on request.

Proposed intake playbook (high level):
- Hightower uploads artifacts to a dedicated, short-lived S3 intake bucket via pre-signed URLs we generate.
- Each artifact accompanied by a manifest row (filename, size, sha256, owner, artifact_type).
- Redwood performs automated validation and confirms receipt; we store artifacts in an encrypted archive with limited, audited access.
- For very large exports or restricted networks, we can provision an SFTP drop with per-key accounts.

I've drafted a short playbook and included it as an attachment (redwood-evidence-playbook-draft.pdf) — Kim (security ops) can speak to the validation pipeline and access controls.

I'm available Mon 8/25 at 10:00 PT for a 30-min sync — does that work for you? If not, propose two alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Sales (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-evidence-playbook-draft.pdf

Date: Sun, 24 Aug 2025 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence transfer — technical notes

Hi Alice — quick technical follow-up from security ops.

A few specifics to help your team prep: 
- Preferred: S3 pre-signed PUT URLs. Files should be encrypted in transit (TLS) — we accept server-side encryption but recommend client-side AES-256 for extra assurance.
- Naming convention: <customer>-<artifact_type>-<YYYYMMDD>-<sha256prefix>. Example: hightower-config-20250820-a1b2c3.json
- Manifest: CSV with columns [filename,size,sha256,artifact_type,owner,email,tags]. We validate sha256 and reject mismatches.
- Max single file size: 10GB via pre-signed URL; for larger datasets we can provide multipart guidance or temporary SFTP.
- Access auditing: uploads are time-bound and logged; we provide a receipt email listing items ingested.

If you need PGP, we can share a public key (let us know). I've attached a short transfer checklist (transfer_instructions_v1.md) and a one-click calendar invite link for 8/25 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: transfer_instructions_v1.md

Alice / Ben — thanks for the sync today. Quick summary and action list from Redwood's side.

Meeting highlights:
- Agreed intake: S3 pre-signed URLs for bulk uploads, SFTP as backup.
- Manifest required for all uploads (we reviewed sample columns).
- Redwood will validate sha256 and confirm via receipt emails.
- Redwood to provide a 10MB sample log export for parsing validation.
- Retention: default evidence retention for onboarding/soc2 is 12 months; can be extended on request (we'll document in the MSA addendum).

Action items (owners / ETA):
1) Kimberly to share Redwood public PGP key and the transfer checklist (ETA: 2025-08-26) — owner: kimberly_park@redwood.com
2) David to provision an intake S3 bucket + pre-signed URL generator for Hightower and hand over access details (ETA: 2025-08-26) — owner: david_kim@redwood.com
3) Markus to circulate the final evidence playbook and a sample receipt template (ETA: 2025-08-27) — owner: markus_klein@redwood.com
4) Hightower to upload initial manifest + a small set of sample logs to the Drive link and/or S3 presigned URLs (ETA: 2025-08-25 EOD) — owner: Alice Weaver <alice@hightower.io>

Attachments: soc2-evidence-inventory.xlsx (I'll attach the template and the receipt example in the playbook email).

Next steps: we'll follow up with the playbook and the sample log within 24 hours. If anything urgent shows up before then, reply-all or ping Kim directly.
